name: Yagyin's Digest
summary: Yagyin’s Digest is a book entrusted to you in the Badlands. Theldurin believes its truths may help save those threatened by what lies beneath the earth.

sections.title: A Dangerous Book
sections.body: Theldurin gives you Yagyin’s Digest to carry through the Badlands. He warns that its truths can burn and asks you to keep it from unfriendly hands. The book matters to those who fear what may rise from below.

faq.answer: Yagyin’s Digest is a book Theldurin entrusts to you. He says it holds many truths and warns that the truth can burn.

aliases: who do I bring it to
faq.answer: Theldurin is the one who gives you Yagyin’s Digest and asks you to keep it from unfriendly hands.
Theldurin warns that the truths in Yagyin’s Digest can burn. He does not want it to reach unfriendly hands.

faq.q: What might the book help prevent?
faq.answer: Theldurin hopes your efforts may help save those threatened if the beings below are freed and rise to the surface.
